Installing seabORD

Source: vignettes/A_installing_seabord.Rmd
A_installing_seabord.Rmd

Installing seabORD

This guide explains how to install seabORD directly from GitHub. Before getting started, ensure that you have R and RStudio installed and up to date.

Prerequisites

To install packages from GitHub, you will need the pak package:

install.packages("pak")

Installing seabORD

Install the latest development version from GitHub with:

pak::pkg_install("NERC-CEH/seabORD")

Load the package

Once installation is complete, load the package in your R session:

library(seabORD)

Updating seabORD

To update to the latest version, rerun:

remotes::install_github("NERC-CEH/seabORD")

Next steps

Read more about the seabORD model, read about its inputs, or its main functions, or start following the examples!
